text: As of February 2008, the FDA had received reports of 50 adverse events, including 23 deaths, associated with the unapproved use of intravenous colchicine. Three of the reported deaths were as- sociated with compounded colchicine that, due to preparation er- rors, was 8 times more potent than the amount stated on the label. Potentially fatal effects include neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, pancytopenia, acute renal failure, and congestive heart failure.1,2 1. FDA. FDA takes action to stop the marketing of unapproved in- jectable drugs containing colchicine (issued 6th February 2008).
